title: Icon lacks distinction between Not Charging (Plugged in but not charging) vs Charging (Plugged in and charging)
line: The Power and Battery tray icon and popup icon no longer show the charging plug when the battery is plugged in but not charging.
explanation: The battery applet passed the AC-present flag straight to the battery icon, and the icon adds the '-charging' (plug) variant whenever that flag is set. So with AC connected and UPower reporting the battery as not charging (pending-charge), the tray icon and the popup's battery icon looked exactly like an actively charging battery, even though the popup text said 'Not Charging'. The change only passes the plug flag when the overall (tray) or per-battery (popup) state is Charging or Fully Charged, so a not-charging battery shows the plain level icon. The charge-limit case is unaffected, because the model already reports a battery stopped at its charge threshold as Fully Charged.

commits.message:
applets/batterymonitor: show the plug badge only while charging

The tray and popup battery icons got the plug badge whenever AC was
present, so a battery that is plugged in but not charging looked like
one that is charging. Only add it when charging or fully charged.

BUG: 525429

patches.diff:
From 788bed88cc73e97587f44cf2c244be217d876777 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 00:58:39 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/batterymonitor: show the plug badge only while
 charging

The tray and popup battery icons got the plug badge whenever AC was
present, so a battery that is plugged in but not charging looked like
one that is charging. Only add it when charging or fully charged.

BUG: 525429
---
 applets/batterymonitor/BatteryItem.qml | 1 +
 applets/batterymonitor/main.qml        | 2 +-
 2 files changed, 2 insertions(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/applets/batterymonitor/BatteryItem.qml b/applets/batterymonitor/BatteryItem.qml
index 51c708a4c..f633ad212 100644
--- a/applets/batterymonitor/BatteryItem.qml
+++ b/applets/batterymonitor/BatteryItem.qml
@@ -75,6 +75,7 @@ PlasmaComponents3.ItemDelegate {
             percent: Math.max(0, root.batteryPercent)
             hasBattery: root.batteryPluggedIn && root.batteryPercentKnown
             pluggedIn: root.pluggedIn && root.batteryIsPowerSupply
+                && [BatteryControlModel.Charging, BatteryControlModel.FullyCharged].includes(root.batteryChargeState)
         }
 
         ColumnLayout {
diff --git a/applets/batterymonitor/main.qml b/applets/batterymonitor/main.qml
index 7999bddb3..f747b0416 100644
--- a/applets/batterymonitor/main.qml
+++ b/applets/batterymonitor/main.qml
@@ -214,7 +214,7 @@ PlasmoidItem {
     compactRepresentation: CompactRepresentation {
         Accessible.description: `${batterymonitor.toolTipMainText}; ${batterymonitor.toolTipSubText}`
         batteryPercent: batteryControl.percent
-        batteryPluggedIn: batteryControl.pluggedIn
+        batteryPluggedIn: batteryControl.pluggedIn && [BatteryControlModel.Charging, BatteryControlModel.FullyCharged].includes(batteryControl.state)
         hasBatteries: batteryControl.hasBatteries
         hasInternalBatteries: batteryControl.hasInternalBatteries
         hasCumulative: batteryControl.hasCumulative
--

media.caption: Pure master, AC online, battery at 57% in UPower state pending-charge: popup says 'Not Charging 57%' but both the popup and tray icons show the charging plug
Same state with the fix: popup and tray show the plain 57% battery icon, no plug
Pure master, same battery actively charging: identical plug icon to the not-charging case
With the fix, actively charging still shows the plug, so the two states are now distinguishable

review.text: Clean, minimal fix in the right layer (powerdevil's batterymonitor applet) that only shows the charging plug badge when AC is connected and the state is Charging or FullyCharged. It accurately distinguishes 'Not Charging' from active charging in both the tray icon and popup delegate while preserving the plug badge for 100% / charge-threshold FullyCharged states and matching existing QML idioms. Before/after screenshots, regression checks, commit message, and batteryitemtest all verify the change cleanly.

reviews.text: Clean, minimal fix in the right layer (powerdevil's batterymonitor applet) that only shows the charging plug badge when AC is connected and the state is Charging or FullyCharged. It accurately distinguishes 'Not Charging' from active charging in both the tray icon and popup delegate while preserving the plug badge for 100% / charge-threshold FullyCharged states and matching existing QML idioms. Before/after screenshots, regression checks, commit message, and batteryitemtest all verify the change cleanly.

Fixes exactly what the title and the reporter ask (they explicitly accept omitting the charging glyph), in the right place: the applet fed the AC-present flag to the icon, so only the applet needs to gate it on Charging/FullyCharged. I checked BatteryControlModel in plasma-workspace: NoCharge within ±1% of the stop threshold is already mapped to FullyCharged, so charge-limited laptops keep the plug when parked at the limit, as the explanation says. Before/after screenshots clearly show the tray and popup icons losing the plug only in the Not Charging state, with charging, full and discharging regression-checked. Minor nit only: a plugged-in, not-charging battery now looks the same as on battery in the tray (the tooltip and popup text still tell them apart), which is the trade-off the reporter offered.
